{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: 1/4-20 x 3/4" (30 pcs) Flat Head Machine Screws, 304 Stainless Steel (18-8), Phillips Drive, Cross Recessed 80° countersunk Head Screws, Coarse Thread UNC, ANSI B18.6.3-2; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These could complement my UNC rivet nuts for assemblies needing flush screw heads, though I would check the required length first.
ItemID: 2; Title: haisstronica 160PCS Yellow Heat Shrink Spade Connectors,AWG 12-10 Heat Shrink Spade Terminlas Kit,Male and Female Electrical Quick Disconnect Wire Connectors; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on mechanical fabrication supplies and have no current wiring job requiring these connectors.
ItemID: 3; Title: VIGRUE 310 Pcs #6 1/2'' to 1'' #8 1/2'' to 1-1/2'' Wood Screws Black Oxide Coated Stainless Steel Flat Head Phillips Drywall Screw Assortment Kit, Self Tapping Screws Kit in 8 Sizes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The assortment fits my DIY work, but I already have a large wood screw kit and would skip another until I need replenishment.
ItemID: 4; Title: 100 Nitrile Exam Gloves 3.5 Mil - Latex & Powder Free, Disposable Non-Sterile Protective Gloves By PlastCare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Disposable gloves would be useful for messy resin and adhesive work, provided their chemical compatibility suits the materials I use.
ItemID: 5; Title: Joywayus Hex Nipple 1/4"NPT Male x 1/4"NPT Male Threaded Stainless Steel 304 Threaded Nipple Pipe Fittings for Brew Kit Home Piping (Pack of 5); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently need to join threaded pipes, so these fittings would likely sit unused.
ItemID: 6; Title: 1/2 Push Connect Valve,CEKER 1/2 inch OD Quick Connect Tube Fittings Pneumatic Valve Push Fittings Union Straight Air Flow Control Valve 1Pack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Nothing in my current projects calls for a pneumatic valve or this tubing size.
ItemID: 7; Title: 2PACK Stainless Mesh Screen 12”X24”(305mmX610mm), 20 Mesh 304 Steel Woven Wire Mesh, 1mm Hole Sturdy Easy to Cut Never Rust by Valchoose; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Cuttable mesh could suit fabrication projects, but I would wait until I have a specific use and know the opening size I need.
ItemID: 8; Title: UltiCare 200mL Utility Syringe – Uses Include Dispensing Liquids for Automotive, Cooking, Crafts, Gardening and Lab Work. Catheter Tip with Nozzle for Finer Application, individually wrapped, 4 Count; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try these for controlled transfer of craft liquids; the large capacity could help with bigger resin projects.
ItemID: 9; Title: Joywayus Pressure Gauge 0 to 30 PSI Brass 1/4" Male NPT Thread Lower Mount, Multiple Function; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I like practical measuring tools, but I have no current pressure-testing task requiring this range and connection.
ItemID: 10; Title: 1095 Steel for Knife Making-3 Pack 1095 Steel Flat Stock,Flat Steel Bars; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My drilling and cutting supplies do not mean I am making knives, and I have no current need for this specialized steel."}
